title: Rethinking Post-hoc Debiasing of Large Pretrained Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.29688v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large pretrained models such as CLIP are widely used as frozen feature extractors. However, their embeddings inherit spurious correlations from training data, introducing bias into the features. A growing body of research has sought to address this issue through post hoc debiasing, leaving the backbone untouched. We discover that despite differing mechanisms, these methods require the bias feature to be identified and expressed in text. This dependency is not innocuous. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate that this requirement incurs an unforeseen penalty in certain scenarios. For example, on the UrbanCars benchmark, having two co-occurring bias attributes, the recent methods underperform a vanilla classifier on biased frozenbackbone features, and even providing ground-truth bias identities does not close the gap. translated_title: 重新思考大型预训练模型的事后去偏
translated_abstract: CLIP等大型预训练模型被广泛用作冻结的特征提取器。然而，它们的嵌入继承了训练数据中的虚假相关性，给特征引入了偏差。越来越多的研究试图通过事后去偏（post-hoc debiasing）来解决这一问题，即保持骨干网络不动。我们发现，尽管机制各异，这些方法都需要将偏差特征识别出来并以文本形式表达。这种依赖并非无害。在本工作中，我们通过实验证明，这一要求在某些场景下会带来不可预见的性能损失。例如，在包含两个共现偏差属性的UrbanCars基准上，近期的这些方法在带有偏差的冻结骨干特征上的表现甚至不如一个普通分类器，即使提供真实偏差身份也无法弥合这一差距。我们进一步表明，这类方法所寻求的模式在冻结特征的几何结构中其实是可以直接观察到的。具体来说，跨类……
tldr: 本文揭示了现有事后去偏方法依赖文本表达偏差特征的局限，证明在多偏差属性场景下其表现甚至不及普通分类器，并指出这些方法所寻求的偏差模式其实可以直接从冻结特征的几何结构中观察到。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that existing post-hoc debiasing methods depend on expressing bias features in text, underperforming even vanilla classifiers in multi-bias scenarios, and shows that the patterns these methods seek are readily observable in the frozen feature geometry.
